messages.subject: Gurdeep | Energy & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Middle East Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Gurdeep,

Your long-standing executive-search work with major companies across India, the Middle East and Africa, together with your Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure and Industrial expertise, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in mining, energy, infrastructure and industrial businesses. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am open to wider Middle East, Africa and international assignments.

I have attached a Kestria-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
